subject: Demo timing & CAPEX window for Q3 evaluation
messages:
From: Liz Harper <liz@calypsoanalytics.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Calypso Analytics Procurement <procurement@calypsoanalytics.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: live demo & procurement timeline

Hi Hannah —

Thanks again for the intro last week. We're ready to see a product demo focused on cost controls (batching / quantization) and the Dedicated offering, but a couple of internal timing constraints popped up on our side: the finance team is doing a CAPEX review the week of Aug 9 and they want a clear cost/benefit deck before that window closes. If we can show the demo and hand off an SOW + procurement checklist before Aug 9, it materially helps our approval.

Are you available for a 60-minute demo the week of Aug 2? If not, can we schedule for the week of Aug 16 (after CAPEX) but with a summary deck that the finance team can use in the meantime?

I attached a quick runbook of procurement questions (procurement-checklist.xlsx) for your team to glance at.

Thanks,
Liz Harper
Head of Data Platform
Calypso Analytics

Attachments: procurement-checklist.xlsx (Excel, 23KB)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liz Harper <liz@calypsoanalytics.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: live demo & procurement timeline

Hi Liz —

Appreciate the context and the checklist. We can absolutely prioritize a focused session that maps to CAPEX review asks: cost breakdown by tpm/token, dedicated capacity SLAs, fallback/region routing, and the SOW economics.

We're a bit booked the week of Aug 2 (several customer Q3 kickoffs), but I can free up a 60-minute slot on
- Tue, Aug 10 10:00–11:00 PT
or
- Wed, Aug 11 14:00–15:00 PT

If CAPEX absolutely requires a pre-Aug 9 deck, we can deliver a 2–3 page executive summary + ballpark SOW by Aug 4 for your finance team to review, and then run the live demo the week of Aug 10. Will that work?

Monica — can you prepare the short exec deck and a draft SOW (light on legal, focused on unit economics) if Liz confirms? Karthik — can you join the Aug 10/11 demo to cover procurement questions?

Cheers,
Hannah Schmitt
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0192

Attachments: SOW-draft-v2.pdf (placeholder)

Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo timing & CAPEX window for Q3 evaluation

Thanks Hannah — I pulled the SOW template and started a short exec summary focused on:
- estimated monthly token spend at 90th percentile load
- dedicated pool sizing options (standard vs. reserved burst)
- expected unit economics improvements from KV caching and quantization profiles

I'll drop a draft SOW-draft-v2.pdf into the thread by EOD Tue (Aug 3) so Liz has something to pass to finance.

Karthik — can you validate the dedicated pool sizing bullets and confirm whether we should include a 30-day canary clause for procurement?

Monica
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachments: (will attach SOW-draft-v2.pdf)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liz Harper <liz@calypsoanalytics.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2026 07:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo timing & CAPEX window for Q3 evaluation

Hi all —

Thanks — Aug 10 at 10:00 PT works for me for the live demo. Confirming:
- We will deliver a 2-page executive summary and the SOW draft to Liz by Aug 4.
- Live demo: Tue, Aug 10, 10:00–11:00 PT (60m) — agenda to include throughput/latency, cost controls, deployment options, and procurement Q&A.

Liz — quick procurement note from our side: if Calypso intends to route payment through a PO and CAPEX approval, procurement typically needs:
1) a high-level SOW (deliverable + payment milestones)
2) pricing table with committed vs. burst rates
3) data handling and audit log summary (SOC2 + region)
4) estimated start date (we can align to Sep 1 start for Q3 capacity if approved)

If you can share the procurement contact or a preferred PO cadence, we can draft the pricing table to match.

See you on Aug 10 — Hannah, Monica, I'll coordinate a calendar invite and a short pre-demo prep call 30 minutes before.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Solutions Architecture | Redwood Inference
